extras: Should work on mobile (touch and pen), but it is not tested on a real device yet. Obsidian Sync Standard does not sync files over 5 MB, so install the plugin on each device. Web embeds may show a blank box if the target site forbids framing.
motivation: A fully vibe-coded Obsidian plugin I made for myself, built with contexture.
problem: Traditional slide decks lack the flexibility to incorporate free-form drawing, dynamic content, and multiple presentation steps within a single slide.
summary: A slide deck plugin where each slide is an infinite Excalidraw canvas, allowing users to save views, embed dynamic content, and present the deck.
